decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

The pruning works hereby approved shall not exceed the previous points and shall leave the 'knuckles' in situ. The pruning works shall be limited to the periphery of the crown only and shall leave all epicormic shoots etc within the crown structure in situ. The pruning works shall only be carried out strictly in accordance with British Standard 3998 [2010] 'Tree Works'.Reason: In the interests of the health, safety and appearance of the preserved tree.

Tree work should not be carried out during periods that are likely to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to comply with the requirements of the Wildlife and Countryside Act (1981) and Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations (2010).
description: Works to a tree covered by LBE ORDER NO 1 :Tree no. T004/159 (in red on sketch plan) : 1x Hybrid Black Poplar - crown reduction consisting of pruning the re-growth back to the most recent points, without cutting into or removing the knuckles, all pruning to be limited to the periphery of the crown only, epicormic growth remaining in the inner crown.
